routes.name: Sample Route 12 - North Loop
routes.description: Fictional normal route: industrial park, a food plant and two small offices.

notes.title: Steel-toe boots on this route
notes.body: Ridgeline Steel and Harbor Point Foods both require steel-toe boots and a hard hat for dock access. Keep both in the van.

notes.title: Route runs tight on Fridays
notes.body: Volume is heaviest Friday. Start with Harbor Point Foods before 8:00 so the dock is clear.

notes.title: Gate keypad
notes.body: Main gate keypad code is 0000#. (Sample value, not a real code.) Resets monthly - confirm with the dock supervisor if it does not work.

notes.title: Dock supervisor
notes.body: Dana Reyes, 555-0101. On site 6:00 to 14:30. Ask for her before using dock door 3.

notes.title: Hard hat zone
notes.body: Hard hat required past the yellow line. Forklift traffic is constant between dock doors 2 and 4.

notes.title: Parking
notes.body: Do not park in front of the dock doors - loading trucks need that space. Park along the fence line to the east instead.

notes.title: Hairnet and smock
notes.body: Hairnet and beard net required past the lobby. Spares are in the box by the sign-in desk.

notes.title: Front desk drop
notes.body: Leave the bag with the front desk. Back door is staff only and locked after 9:00.

routes.name: Sample Route 18 - South Corridor
routes.description: Fictional route: school, tire shop and a bakery with an early window.

notes.title: School delivery window
notes.body: Pinecrest Elementary only accepts deliveries between 6:30 and 9:00. Check in at the office first.

notes.title: Check in at the office
notes.body: Sign in at the front office and wear the visitor badge. Deliver to the custodian closet by the gym.

notes.title: Bus loop
notes.body: Bus loop is busy 7:15 to 8:00. Use the side lot and walk the cart across at the crosswalk.

notes.title: Shop foreman
notes.body: Rick Dalton, 555-0114. Call when you pull in; he opens bay 2 for the drop.

notes.title: Back door, before 11:00
notes.body: Back door keypad is 1111*. (Sample value, not a real code.) Deliver before the lunch rush.

notes.title: Alley parking
notes.body: The alley fits one van. Do not block the flour delivery bay on Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
